identity.name: DWH Retention Hold and Policy Conflict

purpose: Define explicit holds and conflict resolution when retention, purge, archival or preservation policies disagree, defaulting to fail-closed preservation rather than silent destruction.

owns: DWH Retention Hold and Policy Conflict semantics

entities.name: DWH Retention Hold and Policy Conflict

value.hold_rule: A hold is an explicit policy identity bound to exact data/scope and lifecycle actions it blocks.
value.effect_rule: Active hold can block purge/destructive transitions according to its declared scope.
value.conflict_rule: Conflicting retention/hold policies are resolved by explicit policy precedence/combination semantics.
value.default_rule: If destructive eligibility is ambiguous, destructive transition hard-fails/preserves data until policy is resolved.
value.history_rule: Hold creation/removal and conflict decisions retain provenance.
value.authority_rule: Removing/bypassing a hold requires explicit authority according to policy.
value.classification_rule: Hold semantics do not change data classification.
value.expiry_rule: A hold may outlive ordinary retention expiry without changing underlying semantic ownership.

references.purpose: Holds participate in retention decision closure.
